the pass-through arm is RECORDED, not recomputed here: §2a's arithmetic ran inside scripts/selector_direct_path.py and the residuals it needs were never cached. It is admitted against that run's own offline identity gate -- the same offline path fed the FULL observed displacement reproduces the treatment's forward to 3.4e-05 nats, against the 1e-4 the run registered. That is the closest available analogue of the zero-shift assertion and it is weaker than it.

the stimulus floor of this quantity is 0 by cancellation: treatment and pass-through read the SAME candidate texts with the SAME readout, so whatever the wording gives away is in both arms and subtracts out. 90% lower bound on the gain: +1.5630 resampling the 48 cases, which is the form the record carries, and +1.5650 resampling the 8 independent units instead. The case bootstrap is the narrower interval because it pretends to more evidence than the design has.
